tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Locality]

↗ def:connection

1. ch4:4.1

If $ abla $ is a connection, then $ abla _XY|_p$ depends only on the germs of $X,Y$ near $p$: if $X=\widetilde X$ and $Y=\widetilde Y$ near $p$, then $ abla _XY|_p= abla _{\widetilde X}\widetilde Y|_p$.
Proof

\sketch If $Y$ vanishes near $p$, choose a bump function $\varphi $ supported there with $\varphi (p)=1$. Since $\varphi Y=0$, the product rule gives

egin{equation} 0= abla _X(\varphi Y)=(X\varphi )Y+\varphi abla _XY. ag {4.5} \end{equation}

Both terms except $ abla _XY|_p$ vanish at $p$. The argument for changing $X$ is analogous, using $C^\infty $-linearity in the first slot.

□
